about.en: USO is the United States Oil Fund, LP, an exchange-traded commodity pool managed by United States Commodity Funds LLC and listed on NYSE Arca. It seeks daily changes in its net asset value that track the daily changes in the price of West Texas Intermediate light sweet crude oil, mainly by holding near-month WTI futures contracts, so its returns can diverge from the spot oil price through futures roll costs. It is a fund share, not oil or an oil futures contract itself.
